_comment: Insurance (DESIGN.md §2), read by Insurance. Each insurer is a trader: rate is the share of an item's value insuring it costs (at least RaidConfig.insurance_min_price), return_hours how long (game hours, random between the two) until lost insured items come back. game_hours_per_real_minute: game time runs this fast against real time (24: a game day is a real minute). taken: when you die, each insured item someone could take is gone for good with chance base + per_looter for every hostile AI alive within radius metres of where you fell (at most max); missing in action, nobody is there to take anything.
